features.name: Spirit
features.summary: Channel one legendary spirit each day, gaining its spirit bonus, séance boon, powers, and spell access.

features.name: Spirit Bonus
features.summary: Gain the channeled legend's bonus on its associated checks, increasing every 4 levels.

features.name: Spirit Surge
features.summary: Allow the spirit 1 influence to add 1d6 to a failed associated d20 roll; the die improves with level.

features.name: Shared Séance
features.summary: Grant the spirit's séance boon to participating allies.

features.name: Taboo
features.summary: Accept a spirit taboo to gain two additional spirit-surge uses before increasing influence.

features.name: Haunt Channeler
features.summary: Channel a haunt into yourself, gaining information and making the haunt easier to destroy.

features.name: Location Channel
features.summary: Contact a legendary spirit without a suitable séance location by accepting additional influence.

features.name: Connection Channel
features.summary: Use a personal connection to channel a specific spirit associated with a legend.

features.name: Propitiation
features.summary: Perform a costly ritual to reduce spirit influence by 1 once per day.

features.name: Astral Journey
features.summary: Travel to the Astral Plane using a séance ritual.

features.name: Trance of Three
features.summary: Temporarily access a lesser power from a second legendary spirit.

features.name: Spacious Soul
features.summary: Accept more influence before losing control and gain improved protection against possession.

features.name: Spirit Mastery
features.summary: Use spirit surge without increasing influence once each round.

features.name: Astral Beacon
features.summary: Channel spirits without a séance and share multiple spirit benefits with allies.
